fields.FIR_Description: During the night of 2026-07-04, around 03:25, a white motorcycle bearing registration number TN-47-ZZ-1041 belonging to the complainant was taken from Neithal Garden Apartment Complex in Salem, according to the complaint recorded on 2026-07-04. A further person, Lokesh Karuppasamy, a co-worker, using the number 9000000097, is stated to be associated with the incident. The complainant alleged that Rajesh Chandran may be involved and provided the mobile number 9000000486. Potentially relevant material referenced includes photographs, CCTV footage and a vehicle observation.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Vehicle reportedly taken during the night from a residential parking spot.
fields.Keywords: motorcycle theft, vehicle, apartment complex, associate, night, suspect, motorcycle, photograph
